Controls The controls menu is a table now: one row per action, keyboard and mouse in one column, gamepad in the other. Key names are written out instead of tiny glyphs. events.title: Introducing the Master Builders
events.summary: Never Sort By Color is a game about a mountain of loose bricks and the one rule that tames it. But sorting is only half of it. The other half is the MOC build: you find an instruction book lying around the workshop, open it, work the pick list, and watch the model click together part by part. Then it stays. events.title: Go Play Librarian - Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
events.summary: Never Sort By Color has an inspiration: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! by ArtRising. You've probably already spotted the kindred spirit. Consider this the formal introduction. The setup: a fairy has trashed a gorgeous arcane library, 3,072 books are scattered across the floor, and the doors stay sealed until every single volume is back in its proper place. That's it. That's the game. And it is wonderful. I literally bought Librarian after watching 30 seconds of a YouTube video about it.
